description: This file implements a handler class for interfacing with Google AI Studio Files API, including functionality for transforming request/response formats and managing file uploads specifically for Gemini models within the litellm framework.

classes.name: GoogleAIStudioFilesHandler
classes.description: Handler class for managing file uploads and transformations for Google AI Studio Files API within the Gemini context.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for file upload based on provided base URL and API key.

methods.name: List[OpenAICreateFileRequestOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns an empty list, indicating no special OpenAI parameters are supported.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps optional parameters for OpenAI requests; currently returns the optional parameters unchanged.

methods.name: dict transform_create_file_request( self, model: str, create_file_data: CreateFileRequest, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms a generic CreateFileRequest into Gemini's format, preparing headers and data for resumable upload.

methods.name: OpenAIFileObject transform_create_file_response( self, model: Optional[str], raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Parses Gemini's upload response to produce an OpenAI-style FileObject with relevant file metadata.
